poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Stand with the bar at your hips and your knees slightly bent.

poses.label: Hinge
poses.description: Push your hips back and keep the bar close as it slides down your thighs.

poses.label: Stretch
poses.description: Stop at a hamstring stretch while keeping your back steady and your arms long.

poses.label: Stand up
poses.description: Drive your hips forward and stand tall with the bar close.

limitations: The loop starts from standing and illustrates the working range. It does not show picking up the bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
